title: docs(rules): add the Soroban CLI reference link to SS-004
problem: SS-004 documents error handling but links only to the errors-and-fees page.
why: An additional authoritative reference helps contributors and users.
scope: Add one relevant reference URL to SS-004's metadata and its docs page.
guidance: Use the Stellar developers documentation and verify the link resolves.

title: test(corpus): add a second negative fixture for SS-003
problem: SS-003 has one negative (a caller-supplied collection) and would benefit from another legitimate bounded loop.
why: More negatives protect against false positives.
guidance: The corpus test currently requires `negative.rs`; extend it to accept additional `negativeN.rs` files.

title: feat(cli): add usage examples to `scan --help`
problem: `scan --help` lists options but shows no examples.
why: Examples are the fastest way to learn the CLI.
scope: Add an `after_help` block with three common invocations.
guidance: Keep examples copy-pasteable and consistent with `docs/cli.md`.
acceptance: Test asserts an example string is present

title: docs: add a troubleshooting entry for findings on unchanged lines
problem: Users are surprised when a baseline makes a finding appear on a shifted line, or when a finding reports a line they did not edit.
why: Explaining fingerprint semantics prevents confusion and unnecessary bug reports.
scope: Add a troubleshooting entry explaining line-independent fingerprints with a pointer to `baselines.md`.

title: test(core): cover severity and confidence parsing aliases
problem: `from_str` accepts aliases like `med` and `crit`, but only a subset is tested.
why: Untested parsing aliases can silently regress configuration handling.
scope: Add unit tests for every accepted alias and a rejection case.

title: docs: add a short quickstart to the README
problem: The README is thorough but a new user must scan several sections to run their first scan.
why: A tight quickstart improves first-run success.
scope: Add a four-command quickstart near the top, linking to Getting Started.
